decisions.reason: The data processing agreement tool draws on the firm's documented compliance know-how and agency focus, and the customer praise for its agency templates is feedback the firm can absorb and build on, though as a niche add-on it stays somewhat exposed.
The flagship management platform extends the firm's owned infrastructure and integrated tooling, sits at the centre of its agency-focused direction, and is where its in-house R&D adds the most value.

The configurable managed hosting plan is a close variant of the core hosting offer on the containerized architecture, so the firm can readily read its results and refine it, though it could later be folded into the plan lineup.

Extended PHP security support builds directly on the firm's technical security expertise and serves agencies with legacy projects, though it is only mentioned on the website and depends on PHP version lifecycles.
